Provide a method of air exchange

objective.explanation: Fainting is brief loss from reduced brain blood.

objective.question: Sudden fall of high temperature to subnormal or normal is:
objective.explanation: Crisis is sudden fall of fever.

objective.explanation: Care for the most life-threatening first.

objective.question: It is advisable to avoid moving an injured victim until all injuries are identified so that:
options: The victim does not get unnecessary pain
The victim does not get further injuries

The goal of first aid for the eye with an impaled object in it is to:
objective.explanation: Stabilise; do not remove the object.

objective.question: The commonest temperature taken by the first aider in the field is the:
objective.explanation: Relative skin temperature is commonest in the field.

objective.question: A first aider can prevent infection of the wound by the following, except:
options: Applying an antibiotic on the wound
Rinsing the wound and covering it

For an infant who is choking, it is advisable to perform:
options: Strong back blows and chest thrusts
Hold infant upside down and strike
objective.explanation: Back blows and chest thrusts for infants.

objective.question: For a victim with a burnt hand, put the hand in cool water if the burns:
options: Are minor with no open blisters
objective.explanation: Cool minor burns without open blisters.

objective.question: For a 15-year-old who has splashed a chemical on his face, one would:
options: Have the victim stay calm until ambulance
Continuously flush with large amounts of water

structured.question: Outline four situations that may lead to choking. (4 marks)
markingGuide: Four causes such as food, toys, vomit, swelling: 4 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Food, small objects, vomit and swelling can cause choking.

structured.question: Outline the four types of burn injury. (4 marks)
markingGuide: Four types such as thermal, chemical, electrical, radiation: 4 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Thermal, chemical, electrical and radiation burns.

structured.question: Outline four importance of putting a patient in a recovery position. (4 marks)
markingGuide: Four reasons such as airway, drainage, breathing: 4 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Maintains airway, allows drainage, aids breathing and monitoring.

structured.question: Explain the acronym "AVPU" as used in assessment of unconscious casualties. (4 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Alert, responds to Voice, responds to Pain, Unresponsive.

structured.question: Mention four qualities of a good nurse. (4 marks)
markingGuide: Four qualities such as caring and competent: 4 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Caring, competent, honest, observant and accountable.
